description: The plot illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and accuracy for three different metrics. The x-axis is labeled “Initial Confidence” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.95 to 0.99, with tick labels at intervals of 0.01. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A blue line with circle markers represents “Δ Acc”, starting at approximately 0.82 at an initial confidence of 0.95 and decreasing to approximately 0.81 at an initial confidence of 0.99. An orange dashed line represents “Acc”, beginning at approximately 0.84 at an initial confidence of 0.95 and decreasing to approximately 0.82 at an initial confidence of 0.99. A green dashed line represents “Initial Acc”, starting at approximately 0.02 at an initial confidence of 0.95 and increasing to approximately 0.24 at an initial confidence of 0.99. Each data point on the lines is accompanied by an error bar.
